headline: Premise Health's filings still put the insider theft at about 2.76 million people; why the employee took the data is still not known.
summary: Re-read Premise Health's notice (s001, unchanged), the Oregon DOJ entry (s003: 2,760,238, Mar 26 to Mar 30) and the Washington AG entry (s004: 49,444), all unchanged.
